name: Spark Double
description: Cast a double that crackles with small sparks so that an opponent's sight and soul-sense both jump after it.

name: Charged Shade
description: Charge the shade so that a soul-bolt that meets it is shoved aside by a flash of repelling force.

name: Crackling Stride
description: Pass the body through a crackling double to the far side in the time of a single spark.

name: Arc Likeness
description: Send a likeness that arcs from the student to an opponent and shocks the soul where it lands.

name: Static Image
description: Hold a static image on the field so that any soul that moves near it makes the image crackle.

name: Live Echo
description: Keep a live echo before the student that sheds a bright crackle at any soul-strike that touches it.

name: Thunder Retinue
description: Loose a retinue of charged phantoms across the field so that each strikes with a flash and a crack.

name: Forked Phantom
description: Split the phantom into forks that find the gaps in a guard and meet inside it.

name: Lightning Revenant
description: Cast a revenant of white fire that falls on one opponent faster than the soul can defend.

name: Thunder Phantasm
description: streams: Phantom Soul + Lightning; fuse a phantom of the soul with a bolt of lightning so that one striking figure passes through every ward and burns the soul behind it.

name: Pale Mourner
description: Show a pale mourner walking beside the student so that an opponent hesitates before striking either.

name: Funeral Shade
description: Stand a funeral shade before the student so that its cold stills a soul-strike that reaches it.

name: Passing Shade
description: Pass through a shade that fades as the student leaves it and arrive a long stride away.

name: Failing Echo
description: Send an echo that carries a dying breath and chills the soul of the one it touches.

name: Ashen Likeness
description: Show an ashen likeness of the opponent's own face so that the opponent doubts which of the two is the living one.

name: Cold Image
description: Cool an image against a soul to learn how near it stands to its end.

name: Wake Double
description: Hold a double of those the student has lost between self and a soul-bolt so that the bolt is turned by their stillness.

name: Deathless Retinue
description: Raise a retinue of figures that cannot be killed again and set them round the student against a heavy assault.

name: Mortal Reflection
description: Show an opponent the opponent's own death in a reflection that reaches the soul through the guard.

name: Silent Revenant
description: Cast a revenant that makes no sound and settles on the soul to press its strength down.

name: Revenant Silence
description: streams: Phantom Soul + Death; join a phantom of the soul to the death stream so that a silent figure ends the opponent's life where it touches the soul.
